answer: In the European Commission’s ‘Artificial Intelligence for Europe’ communication, around EUR 1.1 billion was invested in AI-related research and innovation under the Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme during the period 2014-2017. By the end of 2020, the Commission planned to increase investments in AI under Horizon 2020 to around EUR 1.5 billion, which represents an increase of approximately 70%.
